scope: Product Python including patches; excludes tests and development tools
limitation: Static inventory plus manual review, not a proof of every possible runtime path.

manual_review.native_posting: accounting.post_standard inserts/submits standard documents; callers construct fixed voucher types.
manual_review.dynamic_documents: service.insert callers use HS operational types; setup sections/actions are fixed mappings; portal confirmation is read-only and checks its two allowed types.
manual_review.reconciliation: Payment Reconciliation and native cancellation controllers own ledger allocations/reversals.
manual_review.other_writes: Guest CRM, configuration, privacy files and HS patches do not write ledgers.
